setLevel: level = new level; clearParticles(); trackingEmitters.clear() (the injection point)

smartparticles_heap_slot_clear.conversion: @Inject at HEAD of ParticleEngine.setLevel (setLevel): Smart Particles' merged fields spHeapParticles (every slot set to null; the array stays) and spKeep (emptied) are reached by reflection by name and cleared; setLevel runs unchanged. Smart Particles reads only heap slots it wrote in the same tick and empties spKeep before use, so nothing it reads changes. Helper bons.furious.patch.smartparticles_heap.SmartParticlesHeap (runtime flag smartparticlesHeapSlotClear). Fix: particles of a previous level (and that level) stayed referenced from Smart Particles' heap array after a dimension change or a reconnect.
